title: 港铁杨美珍：铁路加地产模式，能否复制到海外？
speaker: Jenny Yeung

segments.en: And if correct me if I'm wrong, the bulk of your earnings are actually from real estate and then you have of course your railway operator, is that something that's unique you think to Hong Kong or is that something you think other railway operators elsewhere can emulate?
segments.zh: 如果我没说错，你们的大部分收入实际上来自地产，当然还有铁路运营。您认为这是香港独有的，还是其他地方铁路运营商可以效仿的？

segments.en: Or is that something that you would want to take outside as you go into other markets specifically?
segments.zh: 还是说您想在其他市场推广这种模式？

segments.en: I would say in fact many cities or places where we go, the government actually love our model. They want to replicate that as well.
segments.zh: 我想说，事实上我们去的许多城市或地方，政府都很喜欢我们的模式。他们也想复制。

segments.en: But there are a few prerequisite for that model to be able to be deployed.
segments.zh: 但这种模式要能够部署，有几个先决条件。

segments.en: For example, rising land price, for example high density, high rise, so that you have enough from the land sale or land development to fund the railway.
segments.zh: 例如，土地价格上升，例如高密度、高层建筑，这样你就有足够的土地出让或土地开发收入来资助铁路。

segments.en: But having said that, we have just one new tender in Australia and Sydney, in an area called Parveta, is exactly they like our model, right?
segments.zh: 话虽如此，我们刚刚在澳大利亚悉尼一个叫Parveta的地区获得一个新招标，正是因为他们喜欢我们的模式。

segments.en: So they now is developing a station and then the development of the vicinity, they are bundling that into one package and we have just one tender and we just start the work.
segments.zh: 他们现在正在开发一个车站及周边开发，将其捆绑成一个项目包，我们刚刚中标并开始工作。

segments.en: Hopefully can use the same model so that they can also use the development to fund part of the railway. If not all of the cap packs and renew cap packs.
segments.zh: 希望能采用同样的模式，这样他们也可以利用开发来资助部分铁路。如果不是全部资本开支和更新资本开支的话。
